rubric.category: Actual supplied artwork and focal cropping
rubric.notes: Independently inspected all four original JPEGs and final browser renders. Cover cropping retains the wheel/hub in New, luminous blue gateway in Resume, timber span and distant arch in Load Game, and diagonal crystal cliff in Browse. Shared blue/violet light and floating ruins are cohesive. Some panoramic context is necessarily lost in portrait cover crops.

At 1280x720 the four approved cards are 247x373 at x139,391,643,895 and y211, with 5px gaps, ending x1142/y584. The larger row matches the authorized enlargement and leaves clearance above the controller footer. Exactly four cards; Resume initially selected.

Enlarged headings and supporting copy are clearer than the previous smaller-card revision. Dark edge scrims and text shadows retain legibility across the bright Resume gateway and muted Load Game sky. Tiny supporting copy remains a deliberate menu style choice.

rubric.category: Actual creature framing and behind-card balance
rubric.notes: Actual animated sorcerer remains behind all four enlarged cards. Crown, eye, orbital rings, outer raised arm and lower robe preserve its silhouette despite greater authorized torso occlusion. Model geometry/materials are unchanged; some outer arm and robe cropping remains.

Actual source images share cold magical light that complements the teal model and particles against warm gold fog. New remains darker than selected Resume because of its actual source lighting and selection hierarchy; no extra brightening or image retouching is needed.

Existing teal cores and soft halos remain visible around the larger row and actual model without preventing text readability. Motion behavior is covered by the model verification artifact; still-image review does not independently measure temporal quality.
